name: Dave Green
bio:
David Green (born 1983) is an American film and music video director. He is well known for directing several music videos and short films, especially working with Miles Fisher. After making his directorial debut with the 2014 film Earth to Echo, he went on to direct other films such as Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Out of the Shadows (2016) and, later, the Warner Bros. Pictures Animation film Coyote vs. Acme (2026).
